edges.notes: Setup script attachFeatureToProduct(): fetch(`https://api.stripe.com/v1/products/${productId}/features`, { method: 'POST' }); Stripe's API is an external host, so it reaches no route in the repo

Client page ('use client') effect: fetch(`/api/verify-email?token=...`), relative, same origin (query dropped). No basePath, rewrites, or trailingSlash in next.config.ts; middleware only redirects page paths. verify-email/route.ts exports GET
fetch('/api/profile', { method: 'PATCH', body: FormData }), same origin; profile/route.ts exports PATCH = withAuth(updateUserProfile)
fetch('/api/password', { method: 'PATCH', body: FormData }), same origin; password/route.ts exports PATCH = withAuth(updatePassword)
fetch('/api/system-status'), GET, same origin. The middleware matches /api/system-status but only calls auth() and NextResponse.next() for it; system-status/route.ts exports GET
fetch('/api/ai/generate-content', { method: 'POST' }), same origin (client form under MyNotesPage); ai/generate-content/route.ts exports POST
fetch('/api/billing/generate-invoice', { method: 'POST' }), same origin; generate-invoice/route.tsx (a valid route file extension) exports POST = withAuth(generateInvoiceHandler)
fetch('/api/forgot-password', { method: 'POST' }), same origin; forgot-password/route.tsx exports POST
fetch('/api/auth/magic-link', { method: 'POST' }), same origin. The static magic-link segment wins over the auth/[...nextauth] catch-all; magic-link/route.tsx exports POST
fetch('/api/reset-password', { method: 'POST' }), same origin; reset-password/route.ts exports POST
fetch('/api/auth/signup', { method: 'POST' }), same origin. The static signup segment wins over the auth/[...nextauth] catch-all; signup/route.tsx exports POST
fetch('/api/billing/generate-invoice-storage', { method: 'POST' }), same origin; generate-invoice-storage/route.tsx exports POST = withAuth(generateInvoiceStorageHandler)

fetch(`/api/billing/download-invoice/${generateData.invoiceNumber}`, { method: 'GET' }), same origin; the runtime value fills the [invoiceNumber] segment, whose route.tsx exports GET = withAuth(downloadInvoiceHandler)

fetch(url), url = forceRefresh ? '/api/system-status?refresh=true' : '/api/system-status' (line 44): both alternatives are the same path once the query is dropped, so one label. Same origin; system-status/route.ts exports GET

NotesApiClient.getNotes(): fetch(url), url = this.baseURL plus an optional query; baseURL is the constructor default '/api/notes' (every construction, in MyNotesPage, NoteForm, and notes.test.ts, passes no base). notes/route.ts exports GET = withAuth(getAllNotes). notes.test.ts mocks global fetch and calls this method; no request expression of its own

NotesApiClient.getNote(id): fetch(`${this.baseURL}/${id}`) on the default base '/api/notes'; the id parameter only fills the [id] segment, so the route is known here (called from NoteForm). notes/[id]/route.ts exports GET = withAuth(getNote)
NotesApiClient.createNote(): fetch(`${this.baseURL}`, { method: 'POST' }) on the default base '/api/notes'; notes/route.ts exports POST = withAuth(createNote)
NotesApiClient.updateNote(id, …): fetch(`${this.baseURL}/${id}`, { method: 'PUT' }) on the default base '/api/notes'; id fills [id]. notes/[id]/route.ts exports PUT = withAuth(editNote)
NotesApiClient.deleteNote(id): fetch(`${this.baseURL}/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' }) on the default base '/api/notes'; id fills [id]. notes/[id]/route.ts exports DELETE = withAuth(deleteNote)

StripeClient.getSubscription(): fetch(`${this.baseURL}/get-subscription`) on the constructor default '/api/billing' (both constructions, DashboardPageClient and SubscriptionPage, pass no base); get-subscription/route.ts exports GET = withAuth(getSubscription)
StripeClient.createSubscription(): fetch(`${this.baseURL}/create-subscription`, { method: 'POST' }) on the default base '/api/billing'; create-subscription/route.ts exports POST
StripeClient.cancelSubscription(): fetch(`${this.baseURL}/cancel-subscription`, { method: 'POST' }) on the default base '/api/billing'; cancel-subscription/route.ts exports POST
StripeClient.createCustomer(): fetch(`${this.baseURL}/create-customer`, { method: 'POST' }) on the default base '/api/billing'; create-customer/route.ts exports POST
StripeClient.checkout(): fetch(`${this.baseURL}/checkout`, { method: 'POST' }) on the default base '/api/billing'; checkout/route.ts exports POST

UsersClient.getUsers(): fetch(url.toString()), url = new URL(this.baseURL + '/users', window.location.origin) plus query params; baseURL is the constructor default '/api' (AdminDashboardPage's two constructions pass no base), so same origin /api/users. users/route.ts exports GET (admin only)
UsersClient.updateUser(id, …): fetch(this.baseURL + `/users/${id}`, { method: 'PATCH' }) on the default base '/api'; id fills [id]. users/[id]/route.ts exports PATCH (admin only)
